facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack woke up. He saw something big. It was a beanstalk. The beanstalk grew tall.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The next morning, Jack looked out the window in surprise. A giant beanstalk had grown where Mother threw the beans. The beanstalk grew tall, reaching high above the clouds. Jack could not believe his eyes. The magic beans were real after all. Jack wanted to climb the beanstalk and see what was up there.
